text: Implement audio device hot-plug and default-device switching (headphone jack, HDMI/DP audio, USB), a per-application volume mixer, and Bluetooth codec selection.

lens: Research spikes and decisions that must precede commitments
text: Decide whether PipeWire is adopted as the native audio server or a native audio object service is built with PipeWire as a compatibility client, after measuring achievable round-trip latency for each.
rationale: Audio is the strictest latency consumer and duplicating PipeWire violates the do-not-replace-mature-systems principle unless justified by measurement.
